HH24:MI'),' ') AS MV_CREATE_DATE FROM MAIN_CNT_MV WHERE AGENT = #{st_com_code} ) A

/*getCommonNoticeList_v2 - 공통 공지사항 (전체 고객사 대상)*/ SELECT * FROM ( SELECT ROWNUM NUM, A.* FROM ( SELECT A.BID, A.BTYPE, A.COMPANY, (SELECT COM_NAME_LOC FROM ICOMCMPY WHERE COM_CODE = A.COMPANY) COM_NAME_LOC, SUBSTRB(A.SUBJECT, 1, 80) SUBJECT, A.REG_USER_NAME, A.REG_DATE, A.IMAGE_KEY, A.IMPORTANT_FLAG, A.ALWAYS_SHOW_FLAG, A.EXPOSE_TARGET, A.ALL_CUSTOMER_FLAG, CASE WHEN R.BID IS NOT NULL THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS READ_YN FROM ICOMBOARD_NOTICE A LEFT OUTER JOIN ICOMBOARD_NOTICE_READ R ON A.BID = R.BID AND A.BTYPE = R.BTYPE AND R.COM_CODE = #{st_com_code} AND R.USER_ID = #{st_user_id} WHERE A.STATUS != 'D' AND A.EXPOSE_TARGET IN ('SEL', 'ALL') AND A.OPEN_FLAG = 'Y' AND A.ALL_CUSTOMER_FLAG = 'Y' AND (A.ALWAYS_SHOW_FLAG = 'Y' OR (A.FROM_DATE <= TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYYMMDD') AND A.TO_DATE >= TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYYMMDD'))) ORDER BY A.IMPORTANT_FLAG DESC, CASE WHEN R.BID IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, A.REG_DATE DESC, A.BID DESC ) A ) WHERE NUM BETWEEN 1 AND 3

/*getCompanyNoticeList_v2 - 거래사별 공지사항 (특정 고객사 선택)*/ SELECT * FROM ( SELECT ROWNUM NUM, A.* FROM ( SELECT N.BID, N.BTYPE, N.COMPANY, (SELECT COM_NAME_LOC FROM ICOMCMPY WHERE COM_CODE = N.COMPANY) COM_NAME_LOC, SUBSTRB(N.SUBJECT, 1, 80) SUBJECT, N.REG_USER_NAME, N.REG_DATE, N.IMAGE_KEY, N.IMPORTANT_FLAG, N.ALWAYS_SHOW_FLAG, N.EXPOSE_TARGET, N.ALL_CUSTOMER_FLAG, CASE WHEN R.BID IS NOT NULL THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS READ_YN FROM ICOMBOARD_NOTICE N LEFT OUTER JOIN ICOMBOARD_NOTICE_READ R ON N.BID = R.BID AND N.BTYPE = R.BTYPE AND R.COM_CODE = #{st_com_code} AND R.USER_ID = #{st_user_id} WHERE N.STATUS != 'D' AND N.EXPOSE_TARGET IN ('SEL', 'ALL') AND N.OPEN_FLAG = 'Y' AND N.ALL_CUSTOMER_FLAG = 'N' AND (N.ALWAYS_SHOW_FLAG = 'Y' OR (N.FROM_DATE <= TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYYMMDD') AND N.TO_DATE >= TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYYMMDD'))) AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM ICOMBOARD_NOTICE_DT DT, ICOMPOHD PO WHERE DT.BID = N.BID AND DT.BTYPE = N.BTYPE AND DT.COM_CODE = PO.BUYER AND PO.AGENT = #{st_com_code} AND PO.PO_CREATE_DATE >= TO_CHAR(ADD_MONTHS(SYSDATE,-3),'YYYYMMDD') AND PO.STATUS <> 'D' ) ORDER BY N.IMPORTANT_FLAG DESC, CASE WHEN R.BID IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, N.REG_DATE DESC, N.BID DESC ) A ) WHERE NUM BETWEEN 1 AND 3

/*getUnreadNoticeCount_v2 - 미확인 공지사항 건수 (공통 + 거래사별)*/ SELECT NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN A.ALL_CUSTOMER_FLAG = 'Y' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS COMMON_UNREAD, NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN A.ALL_CUSTOMER_FLAG = 'N' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS COMPANY_UNREAD, COUNT(*) AS TOTAL_UNREAD FROM ( /* 공통 공지사항 (ALL_CUSTOMER_FLAG = 'Y') */ SELECT A.BID, A.BTYPE, A.ALL_CUSTOMER_FLAG FROM ICOMBOARD_NOTICE A WHERE A.STATUS != 'D' AND A.EXPOSE_TARGET IN ('SEL', 'ALL') AND A.OPEN_FLAG = 'Y' AND A.ALL_CUSTOMER_FLAG = 'Y' AND (A.ALWAYS_SHOW_FLAG = 'Y' OR (A.FROM_DATE <= TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'YYYYMMDD') AND A.TO_DATE >= TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'YYYYMMDD'))) AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM ICOMBOARD_NOTICE_READ R WHERE R.BID = A.BID AND R.BTYPE = A.BTYPE AND R.COM_CODE = #{st_com_code} AND R.USER_ID = #{st_user_id} ) UNION ALL /* 거래사별 공지사항 (ALL_CUSTOMER_FLAG = 'N') */ SELECT N.BID, N.BTYPE, N.ALL_CUSTOMER_FLAG FROM ICOMBOARD_NOTICE N WHERE N.STATUS != 'D' AND N.EXPOSE_TARGET IN ('SEL', 'ALL') AND N.OPEN_FLAG = 'Y' AND N.ALL_CUSTOMER_FLAG = 'N' AND (N.ALWAYS_SHOW_FLAG = 'Y' OR (N.FROM_DATE <= TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'YYYYMMDD') AND N.TO_DATE >= TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'YYYYMMDD'))) AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM ICOMBOARD_NOTICE_DT DT, ICOMPOHD PO WHERE DT.BID = N.BID AND DT.BTYPE = N.BTYPE AND DT.COM_CODE = PO.BUYER AND PO.AGENT = #{st_com_code} AND PO.PO_CREATE_DATE >= TO_CHAR(ADD_MONTHS(SYSDATE,-3),'YYYYMMDD') AND PO.STATUS <> 'D' ) AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM ICOMBOARD_NOTICE_READ R WHERE R.BID = N.BID AND R.BTYPE = N.BTYPE AND R.COM_CODE = #{st_com_code} AND R.USER_ID = #{st_user_id} ) ) A

/*getNewAgentHomePoMngTotal_v2*/ SELECT COUNT( CASE WHEN A.TYPE = 'E' AND A.STATUS IN ('S','RE') THEN 1 END) AS ES_CNT ,COUNT( CASE WHEN A.TYPE = 'E' AND A.STATUS IN ('B','CM') THEN 1 END) AS EBC_CNT ,COUNT( CASE WHEN A.TYPE = 'D' AND A.STATUS IN ('S','RE') THEN 1 END) AS DS_CNT ,COUNT( CASE WHEN A.TYPE = 'D' AND A.STATUS IN ('B','CM') THEN 1 END) AS DBC_CNT ,COUNT( CASE WHEN A.TYPE = 'G' AND A.STATUS IN ('S','RE') THEN 1 END) AS GS_CNT ,COUNT( CASE WHEN A.TYPE = 'G' AND A.STATUS IN ('B','CM') THEN 1 END) AS GBC_CNT ,COUNT( CASE WHEN A.TYPE = 'I' AND A.STATUS IN ('S','RE') THEN 1 END) AS IS_CNT ,COUNT( CASE WHEN A.TYPE = 'I' AND A.STATUS IN ('B','CM') THEN 1 END) AS IBC_CNT FROM KEP_PO_MNG A WHERE 1=1 AND A.AGENT = #{st_com_code} AND TO_CHAR(A.ADD_DATE,'YYYYMMDD') BETWEEN TO_CHAR(ADD_MONTHS(SYSDATE,-3), 'YYYYMMDD') AND TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYYMMDD')

/*getNoticeDetail*/ SELECT A.SUBJECT, A.CONTEXT, A.BID, A.REG_USER_ID, A.REG_DATE, A.PASSWORD, A.IMAGE_KEY, A.REG_USER_NAME, A.BLEVEL, DECODE (A.BTYPE, 'NT', '공지사항', 'EB', 'e-Biz뉴스', 'DI', '전시회소식', 'EM', 'e마켓자료실', 'SI', '상품자료실', 'PI', '구매정보') BTYPE_DIS, DECODE (A.ACL, 'INC', '자사', 'BUY', '구매사', 'SEL', '공급사', 'KEP', 'KEP', 'CST', '특정회사', 'UST', '특정사용자', 'MEB', '회원전용', 'ALL', '전체') ACL_DIS, A.FROM_DATE, A.TO_DATE, (SELECT MAX (BID) FROM ICOMBOARD WHERE STATUS != 'D' AND BTYPE = #{BTYPE} ${WHERE}) MAX_BID, (SELECT MIN (BID) FROM ICOMBOARD WHERE STATUS != 'D' AND BTYPE = #{BTYPE} ${WHERE}) MIN_BID, A.LCOUNT, B.SUBJECT AS N_SUBJECT, C.SUBJECT AS P_SUBJECT, B.BTYPE AS N_BTYPE, C.BTYPE AS P_BTYPE, B.BID AS N_BID, C.BID AS P_BID, B.REG_DATE AS N_REG_DATE, C.REG_DATE AS P_REG_DATE FROM ICOMBOARD A, (SELECT * FROM ICOMBOARD WHERE BTYPE = #{BTYPE} AND BID = NVL((SELECT MAX (BID) FROM ICOMBOARD WHERE STATUS != 'D' AND BTYPE = #{BTYPE} AND BID < #{BID} ${WHERE}),#{BID})) B, (SELECT * FROM ICOMBOARD WHERE BTYPE = #{BTYPE} AND BID = NVL((SELECT MIN (BID) FROM ICOMBOARD WHERE STATUS != 'D' AND BTYPE = #{BTYPE} AND BID > #{BID} ${WHERE}),#{BID})) C WHERE A.BTYPE = #{BTYPE} AND A.BID = #{BID}
